description: MUTATES one existing calendar event the authenticated user owns. Required: event_id (UUID). Optional patch (same fields as log_event): title, date / event_date, time / event_time, end_date, end_time, location, description (alias notes), category, external_url, image_url, timezone, visibility, people / with / person_ids, scoreboard (merged; null clears), reminder_enabled (false turns the push reminder off; needs a timed event to turn on), reminder_minutes_before. Adds a bedtime to a wake-only sleep: event_time (and event_date / end_date when it was the night before). Unknown or other-user event_id returns an error and does not create a row. For food-diary meals, prefer update_food (it syncs the mirrored event). Rebuilds life_state. Requires API key or OAuth with scope context. Share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

date_precision.description: Soft date precision stored in metadata

description.description: Notes about the event (replaces). Empty or null clears. Alias: notes.

end_date.description: Optional end date YYYY-MM-DD (multi-day, or a night that ends the next day)

end_time.description: Optional end time (same formats as event_time)

event_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY. Alias: date.

event_id.description: UUID of a calendar event the authenticated user owns

event_time.description: Start time: 8pm, 20:00, or 20:00:00. Empty or null clears. Alias: time.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional ISO updated_at you last read. Write applies only if unchanged; otherwise code "conflict" with the current record and changes nothing.

external_url.description: Link to the source page, e.g. https://example.com/events/42.

image_url.description: Cover image URL. Empty or null clears.

people.description: People names or person UUIDs to add (event_people role=with). Does not remove existing tags.

items.description: Contact name or id, e.g. Alex.

reminder_enabled.description: Turn the push reminder on or off. A timed event is needed to turn it on; all-day events stay off.

reminder_minutes_before.description: Push lead time in minutes (snapped to 0, 5, 15, 30, 60, 1440 or 10080)

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original successful result)

scoreboard.description: Status data; state required if new; null clears

timezone.description: IANA timezone for wall-clock display. Empty or null clears.

visibility.description: Updates both events.visibility and the enforced events.is_private flag
